name: world-map-leave-sandbox
description: Issue #1809: starting a campaign level while a sandbox game is live asks before discarding it. Player opens the Portfolio from the sandbox Site Map button (menu New Campaign is Coming soon, #2276), clicks Start on Dusty Hollow's card; a leave-confirm modal appears (it names the sandbox, unit-tested in startLevelConfirm.test.ts), the player confirms and Dusty Hollow starts. Every beat after setup is a real click.

steps.description: Player opens the Portfolio from the sandbox Site Map button (the menu's New Campaign is closed, #2276). `state` is the inert paired command.
Player clicks Start on Dusty Hollow while the sandbox is still live; the leave-confirm modal appears and the Portfolio stays up behind it. `state` is the inert paired command.
Player confirms leaving the sandbox; Dusty Hollow starts and the HUD is reachable. Command mode has no portfolio, so the paired command starts the same level.
